display_name: OLED Midrange (LG C4 / Samsung S95D tier)
short_description: Excellent per-pixel OLED with 1,049 nits peak HDR. True blacks, wide color — the sweet spot for home cinema under $2,000.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: Per-pixel OLED — true infinite contrast. contrast_sequential is null; UI should render 'Infinite (OLED)'.

known_limitations: Full-screen brightness drops to ~257 nits due to OLED thermal limits — spec-sheet peak brightness applies only to small bright highlights on dark backgrounds
Living room ambient light erodes the per-pixel black advantage vs. cinema
